notes:
SWIT QB Companion 2.0.0-beta.81

Reconcile helper, Matched tab: each match is labelled Auto-matched, Manually matched or Multi-matched. A new QuickBooks recon column lets you pre-tick one match, the ticked ones, or all.
The Pre-ticks tab is now Pre-ticked: its count is what QuickBooks’ Reconcile window will open already ticked. Items pre-ticked in QuickBooks but not on this statement are flagged.
Fix: an item that was pre-ticked and undone can be pre-ticked again straight away.
